content:
maria.k: Heads-up — noticed a pattern in the preflight telemetry. When incoming embeds include a high-dim vector (>2048) our p99 latency on the embeddings route jumps ~2x even though payload bytes are small. dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/embeds/slo?panelId=9

kevin.r: Hmm. Is that the dim header we added? Any chance clients are sending wrong dims?

maria.k: We see `X-Embed-Dims` present. Example request: ```POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
  Content-Type: application/json
  X-Embed-Dims: 4096
Body: { "input": "..." }```

carla.devex: Quick UX note — customers expect the console to show both bytes and dims for quota/estimates. Right now quota UI only surfaces bytes which is confusing for high-dim models.

john.sre: From runtime side, large dims change memory working set and can evict KV cache; that explains latency. Routing by bytes alone is inadequate.

ben.pd: Product question — do we treat dims as a first-class routing key (like model and region)? That affects billing and quota semantics.

maria.k: Proposal: 1) Add per-route routing rule to consider `dominant_dim_bucket` (e.g., small|medium|large) in addition to bytes. 2) Expose `dim_hint_header` in console so customers can opt-in to dim-aware routing and see cost estimate. 3) Emit telemetry tags `embed.dim_bucket` and `embed.byte_estimate`.

kevin.r: Implementation thought: calculate dim_bucket at ingress from header if present, else fallback to shape inference on first batch. Then include dim_bucket in route decision key (affects shard selection + prefetch).

carla.devex: For console UX: add a toggle "Enable dimension-aware routing" per API key + a per-route slider for "Max payload bytes" and a small badge showing "Typical dims". We should also surface a note: "Enabling dims may change latency/cost."

john.sre: We also need a fastfail path for clients that claim dims but are lying (malformed input) — fallback to bytes-based route within 50ms to avoid head-of-line. Telemetry should record mismatches: `embed.dim_claimed != dim_inferred`

ben.pd: Billing: If dims become a routing key we should avoid sudden customer surprise. Suggest a 30-day "alpha" where we only surface cost delta in console and send opt-in emails. No billing changes until GA.

maria.k: Agreed. For rollout: feature flag gate at control plane (`dim-routing.enabled`), default off. Canary to 5% of traffic for tenants with `opt_in_dim_routing=true`.

kevin.r: Pseudo-config snippet for routing rule: ```- match: endpoint == /v1/embeddings
  route_by: [model, dim_bucket, bytes_bucket]
  fallback: bytes_bucket```

carla.devex: Telemetry dash request: heatmap (dim_bucket vs p99 latency) + per-tenant delta. I'll sketch console mockups.

john.sre: Ops note: update alerting runbook — new alert `embed.dim-induced-slo` when p99 increases >25% for any dim_bucket.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/dim-routing -> staging (build #4321)

maria.k: I'll make a short RFC and own the implementation until canary. Action items: 
- maria.k: RFC + small API sketch by EOD tomorrow
- kevin.r: prototype ingress dim_bucket and fallback logic
- carla.devex: console mockups + messaging copy
- john.sre: alerting rule + mismatch logging
- ben.pd: communication plan (opt-in email + docs)

kevin.r: Sounds good. I'll post a branch with a small ingest shim and sample telemetry tags when available.

carla.devex: @maria.k add me to the RFC — want to include screenshots for the API key settings. :thumbsup:

maria.k: Will do. Thanks all.
